propositions: Residual live prose references to 'Success Criteria' in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl must be migrated to 'Acceptance Criteria' vocabulary.
A deterministic repository-rooted guard script must detect and prevent reintroduction of the deprecated 'Success Criteria' heading across the codebase via a plain-text allowlist with pinned counts.

The guard must enforce count-pinned allowlist rows for exactly four permanent semantic carve-outs (T2 experiment language, definition-of-done concept references, migration/lifecycle test probes, and historical Jira captures) while rejecting unallowlisted matches or count drift.

Scoped bare-token matching for 'SC' or 'SCs' must fail only within src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md; bare tokens outside these paths must not trigger the rule.
The guard must be wired into the root Makefile lint target so that local and CI runs enforce the same vocabulary policy, with deterministic diagnostics identifying path, line, and matched vocabulary.

Four byte-identical O-RAN-SC references in docs/adr files and gerrit-verify.yaml must remain stable and outside the bare-token rule scope; all other exclusions are explicit (docs/archive/**, docs/experiments/**, minified vendor bundle, generated cache/VCS directories).
